_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Search local businesses near a place...

description: Find businesses and services near a place from OpenStreetMap: send what (a category such as cafe, pharmacy, hotel or dentist, or a name such as Starbucks) and near (a place such as "Hoan Kiem, Hanoi") or lat and lon, plus an optional radius_m (default 1500, at most 10000). Nominatim's best text matches in the box around the radius (at most 40), kept when they are a business inside the radius and sorted by distance, so a call can return fewer rows than page_size; each row has title, category, address, lat, lon, distance_m, phone, website and opening_hours where OpenStreetMap has them. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center, with lon.

lon.description: Longitude of the search center, with lat.

near.description: A place to search around, such as "Shibuya, Tokyo" or "10 Downing Street, London"; or send lat and lon.

what.description: A category (cafe, restaurant, pharmacy, hotel, supermarket, dentist...) or a business name.

name: data_local_search
title: Search local businesses near a place
